data.name: Chip package
data.function: Copper enclosure with a printed-circuit board and a lid that forms a cavity around the chip. The cavity's lowest mode must lie well above the qubit and readout band, otherwise it mediates crosstalk and Purcell loss; the lid height and any interior posts set that frequency. The package also provides the ground reference for all on-chip coplanar waveguides.

physics.summary: Encloses the chip; its cavity mode must sit above the operating band.

data.tooltip: Chip package with cavity and PCB.
